subject: general
question: The Atal Innovation Mission was launched in year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) was launched in 2016 as a flagship initiative by the Government of India to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship.
 
• AIM aims to create an ecosystem of innovation and entrepreneurship at various levels in the country, from schools to higher education institutions and beyond.
 
• It focuses on fostering innovation and nurturing an innovative mindset through initiatives like Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs) in schools.
 
• Additionally, AIM supports the establishment of Atal Incubation Centers (AICs) and aims to encourage startups and small businesses to thrive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs)**

 
 
• ATLs are dedicated workspaces where students (Class 6 to Class 12) learn innovation skills and develop ideas that will go on to transform India.
 
• These labs are equipped with state-of-the-art tools and technologies like 3D printers, robotics & electronics development tools, IoT & sensors, etc.
 
• The goal is to foster curiosity, creativity, and imagination in young minds, and inculcate skills such as design mindset, computational thinking, adaptive learning, physical computing, etc.
 
 
 
• **Atal Incubation Centers (AICs)**
 
 
• AIM provides financial support to establish new incubation centers across India.
 
• AICs aim to foster and support world-class innovation and dynamic startups in various sectors, including social innovation.
 
• They provide necessary infrastructure and support to startups, such as mentoring, networking, and access to funding.
 
 
 
• **Atal New India Challenges**
 
 
• These challenges aim to foster product innovations and align them to needs of various sectors/ministries.
 
• The program provides a grant-in-aid of up to Rs. 1 crore for selected innovators/startups to develop their products further.
 
 
 
• **Mentor of Change**
 
 
• This initiative aims to engage leaders who can guide and mentor students in ATLs, entrepreneurs in AICs, and other beneficiaries of AIM programs.
 
• Mentors provide guidance on various aspects like technology development, business strategy, and market access.
